correctness.rationale: The full proof separates all-length published premises from new exhaustive finite verification. All 9,840 words through length eight are tested for both orientations of seven prohibited patterns. The exact survivors are witnessed in the length-65 morphism prefix. No reflected length-eight candidate can occur, and a reflected longer factor would force such a length-eight pair; all higher lengths are thus excluded. The published ordinary count \(2n+1\) and short numbers of nonpalindromic reflected factors yield the exact reflection count. Direct execution of verify.py reproduced every finite claim and gave independent longer-prefix consistency checks.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete computation of a recently formalized invariant for a canonical primitive nonuniform ternary substitution of minimal linear factor growth. It supplies a sharp symmetry transition, the exact orbit census before the transition, and a seven-local-pattern obstruction valid uniformly across all words avoiding those patterns. The precise threshold and table refine the qualitative prior dichotomy and can serve as a benchmark for reversal quotients of substitution languages. The claim is appropriately limited and does not infer a universal bound for unrelated morphisms.
